question.text: Generative test-fit tools win projects through fast, iterative proposals at concept stage. Can the same iterative, rule-based process — and the information models it produces — carry on into design development and construction documents?

hypothesis.text: Rule-based generation produces information models — geometry with data — that can be iterated and carried from concept into production, not only sketched at concept stage.

The number of human hands a model needs from concept to production depends on how much checking its tools can do. Rule-based tools make the passes more frequent and shorter, but the gap between prompt and production model keeps human judgment and signature in the loop.
